page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.xlarge is an x86_64 instance from the High Clock Speed family, hosted via the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz, partitioned into 2 physical cores and 4 vCPUs via multithreading. It provides 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512 (F, VNNI, BF16), AES, and BMI2. The instance contains zero bundled local storage and has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. No hardware accelerators or GPUs are present.

Benchmark evaluations indicate consistent single-threaded execution aligned with middle-tier expectations, driven by the 3.3 GHz clock frequency. The system achieved a single-core score of 1324.0 in Geekbench and 1576.89 in stress-ng. Compression throughput measures 27.0 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip and 10.38 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3. In contrast, multi-core benchmarks show weak relative throughput due to the low overall core count, yielding 2941.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 4151.89 in stress-ng multi-core. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is recorded at 31.07 GB/sec, while write operations reach 25.1 GB/sec. In small language model inference, prompt processing reaches 287.5 tokens per second, with text generation at 77.5 tokens per second.

Because local disk storage is absent, all storage input and output operations must traverse the network, constrained by the 2 Gbps baseline interface. Qualitative cost efficiency is highest when software architecture prioritizes higher per-core processing rates over distributed thread parallelization. The instance is suited for moderate web serving, continuous integration builds, single-threaded batch tasks, and backend API components that do not demand extensive local disk caching or wide multi-core scaling.

The architecture incorporates AVX-512 vector extensions and AES hardware acceleration.
